review:
Bastet's cats on Megaways, with up to 117,649 ways. The book is both wild and scatter, and in free spins it adds a random multiplier to a spin's total win.

The free spins also bring an expanding symbol that pays even on reels that aren't next to each other – unusual for a Megaways game. You can buy regular free spins, or pay more for a high-paying expanding symbol. Very high volatility, 10,000x max, and a 97.07% RTP. Free spins about once every 189 spins. A swingier, stronger upgrade on the original.
pros: Excellent 97.07% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
